messages:
maya_cs: quick ask 1: can we standardize a single 'Launch Signal' one-pager for AMs that covers warmup (prefill), conservative batching, streaming expectations, and a short renewal-risk signal list?

sam_sre: yes. keep it prescriptive: defaults, telemetry to watch, and a tiny paste-ready warmup script. hosted defaults should be conservative.

owen_se: include optional prefill window (24-72h) for heavy template customers and guidance when to increase batch sizes for Dedicated.

rachel_csm: renewal heuristics to call out: 20%+ drop in DAUs within 7d, >10% increase in early support tickets, or sustained p95 latency >750ms -> trigger AM outreach.

maya_cs: paste-ready config (hosted safe defaults):

maya_cs: ```yaml
launch_signal:
  prefill: true
  prefill_window_h: 24
  batch:
    enabled: true
    max_batch_size: 12
    max_wait_ms: 100
  streaming:
    enabled: true
    min_stream_tokens: 6
  circuit_breaker:
    error_rate_threshold: 0.10
    cooldown_s: 300
```

sam_sre: operator warmup script (one-shot):

sam_sre: ```bash
prompts=("welcome" "summary" "faq")
for p in "${prompts[@]}"; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -d '{"model":"gpt-hosted-small","input":"'$p'","prefill":true}' &
done
wait
```

own_se: telemetry to display on AM dashboard (day0-day7): token/sec, p95 latency, cache hit rate (target >65% after warmup), median batch size, streaming fallback %.

rachel_csm: handoff checklist for AMs (short): model & quantization, expected RPM, 3 eval prompts + quality owner, renewal thresholds, oncall escalation.

maya_cs: customer note (non-technical): "Warmup (usually 24-48h) may show slightly higher latency and cost as caches populate. CSM/AM will monitor and adjust. If you see persistent issues, we will pause prefill and revert to conservative settings while we investigate."

sam_sre: troubleshooting quickchecks: cache hit <40% -> verify keys/prefill jobs; p95 >800ms -> reduce max_batch_size or lower max_wait_ms; error rate >threshold -> open CB and page oncall.

rachel_csm: add feedback link in all enablement emails: https://forms.redwood.example/launch-feedback -> auto-tag critical responses to renewal queue.

maya_cs: I'll draft the one-pager and PR it to enablement repo EOD. cc @deploy-bot to queue PR job.
